name: Embryonic limb and digit morphogenesis
rationale: All three members are embryonic limb or digit morphogenesis, distinguishing the theme from craniofacial, neural plate and somite patterning confusables.

name: Methylglyoxal and aldehyde detoxification and protein repair
rationale: Members centre on methylglyoxal/aldehyde removal plus protein repair, DNA protection and molybdenum-cofactor-dependent oxidation, unlike the glutathione, vitamin B6 and ROS-detoxification confusables.

qualifier: cortical lamination and tangential interneuron migration
name: Neuronal migration and cortical lamination in brain development
rationale: Members are radial and tangential neuronal/interneuron migration and cortical layering or regionalization, whereas confusables emphasise commissures, reelin signalling, radial glia differentiation or thalamic/retinal development.

name: BAF complex chromatin remodeling and protein acetylation
rationale: Members combine BAF-family complex formation, nucleosome assembly/disassembly and histone/protein acetylation, while confusables add NuRD, CHD6-9 and histone/DNA methylation.

name: Motile cilia in multiciliated epithelia and sperm flagella
rationale: Members cover axonemal dynein and central apparatus assembly, cilium beat regulation, multiciliogenesis, ependymal CSF flow, mucociliary clearance and sperm motility, unlike primary-cilium IFT, left/right asymmetry or tubulin-modification confusables.

name: Hair cell mechanotransduction in hearing and balance
rationale: Members are hair-cell stereocilia/otolith mechanosensing for sound detection and equilibrioception, gravity and vestibular reflex, whereas confusables concern inner ear morphogenesis, cell fate or microvilli.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
rationale: Members are meiotic DSB formation, strand invasion, recombination, synaptonemal complex and prophase checkpoints, distinct from confusables on cohesion, meiotic segregation, germline epigenetics or mitosis.

name: Hexosamine biosynthesis of UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid
rationale: Members are UDP-N-acetylglucosamine synthesis (GFPT1, ALG14) and sialic acid/CMP-Neu5Ac metabolism (GNE), unlike confusables on dolichol, GDP-mannose or sialic acid catabolism.

name: Skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and maintenance
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle fiber differentiation, myogenesis and muscle cell homeostasis, whereas confusables focus on myoblast fusion, contraction, cardiac growth or regeneration.

qualifier: negative regulation via TLR and IL-1 signaling
name: Suppression of TLR and IL-1 driven inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members negatively regulate TLR2/4, LPS and IL-1 signalling and IL-1, IL-6, IL-12 and TNF production, unlike confusables dominated by positive regulation, inflammasomes or NF-kappaB.

qualifier: complexes I, III and ATP synthase
name: Respiratory complex I, III and ATP synthase assembly
rationale: Members are assembly of complex I, complex III and ATP synthase with inner-membrane protein insertion, distinguishing the theme from complex IV assembly, Fe-S clusters and mitochondrial import confusables.

name: Alditol and glycerol metabolism with polyol-pathway fructose synthesis
rationale: Members are alditol, glycerol and glycerol-3-phosphate metabolism plus fructose biosynthesis, unlike confusables on fructose catabolism, pentoses or acylglycerol synthesis.

core: Regulation of TLR signaling and cytokine production
name: Regulation of TLR3/4 signaling and IL-6/IL-8/TNF induction
rationale: Members regulate TLR/MyD88, CD40 and IL-1 signalling and mostly promote IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike confusables centred on TRIF/IKK adaptors, inflammasomes or negative cytokine regulation.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and erythrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, homeostasis and differentiation together with primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation, unlike confusables on late erythroid maturation, generic stem cell maintenance or bone marrow cell number.

name: Thyroid hormone generation and H2O2 production
rationale: Members cover thyroid hormone synthesis, transport and activity alongside H2O2/ROS biosynthesis needed for iodination, unlike confusables on thyroid hormone receptor signalling, selenium, sulfonation or ascorbate.

name: Epidermal cornification and skin barrier formation
rationale: Members are keratinocyte cornified envelope assembly, cross-linking and skin barrier/epidermis morphogenesis, unlike confusables on adhesion junctions, lipoxygenase lipids or keratinocyte proliferation control.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT
name: Insulin/IGF1 and ALK-family receptor signaling to PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are RTK autophosphorylation and IRS/SHC/SOS signalling to AKT and ERK from IGF1R/insulin and ALK/LTK receptors, unlike FGFR, ERBB, MET or oncogenic fusion confusables.

name: Intestinal lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid, sterol and vitamin E absorption and assembly of chylomicrons and VLDL, whereas confusables concern lipoprotein remodeling/clearance or bile acids.

name: Drug-resistant oncogenic KIT, FLT3 and PDGFR mutant signaling
rationale: All members are KIT, FLT3 or PDGFR mutants and their TKI binding or resistance, distinguishing the theme from ALK and FGFR mutant confusables.

name: Camera-type eye morphogenesis, lens and anterior segment
rationale: Members are eye morphogenesis of lens, iris, cornea, eyelid and optic cup with hyaloid regression and retinal cell death, unlike photoreceptor or optic nerve confusables.

qualifier: transcriptional activation of ER chaperone genes
name: UPR transcription factor activation of ER chaperone genes
rationale: Members are ATF6, XBP1, ATF4 and CREB3 activation of chaperone genes under ER stress, unlike confusables on UPR branch regulation, SREBP or integrated stress response.

name: Threonine-centred amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members are threonine metabolism/catabolism plus general L-amino acid catabolic terms, unlike glycine, proline or acid-conjugation confusables.

name: Phosphate homeostasis via sodium-phosphate cotransport and vitamin D
rationale: Members cover NaPi-II transporters, vitamin D activation/inactivation, PTH and Klotho-FGF signalling controlling phosphate, unlike steroid hormone and tooth mineralization confusables.

name: Fanconi anemia crosslink repair and protein monoubiquitination
rationale: Most members concern Fanconi anemia interstrand crosslink repair and monoubiquitination/deubiquitination, with two loosely related proliferation/mitosis modules, unlike confusables on BRCA DSB response or polyubiquitin chain types.

name: Intestinal epithelial differentiation and structural maintenance
rationale: All members describe intestinal epithelial cell development and maintenance, while confusables emphasise antimicrobial defense or HNF-driven absorptive epithelium identity.
